note: Status Messages renders Drupal status messages as an auto-fading top-right popup. Its only configuration is status_message_time (milliseconds) in the status_messages.status_messages config object, set via the form at /admin/config/user-interface/status-messages (route status_messages.status_messages, permission 'administer status messages configuration'); the select offers 5000/10000/15000/20000/3600000 (Never). The module ships no config/install default and no schema, so status_message_time is unset until saved — the reset/cleanup baseline is therefore 'config object removed'. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that one real config value: introspection reads the current time, execution sets it and verifies against live config.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal 'Status Messages' module change about how Drupal's status/warning/error messages are displayed?
evals.expected_output: It shows the core status messages as a floating popup (toast) in the top-right corner with a close button, and fades them out automatically after a configurable time.

evals.prompt: In the Status Messages module, which config setting controls how long a message stays before fading, what unit is it in, and where is it configured?
evals.expected_output: status_message_time, in milliseconds, stored in the status_messages.status_messages config object and set at /admin/config/user-interface/status-messages. Options are 5000/10000/15000/20000 and 3600000 (Never).

evals.prompt: In Status Messages, what value would I choose so that popup messages effectively never auto-close, and which permission controls access to the settings form?
evals.expected_output: Choose 'Never', which stores status_message_time = 3600000 (one hour, i.e. no auto-close in a normal page view). The settings form is gated by the 'administer status messages configuration' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, how long (in seconds) will Status Messages keep a popup on screen before it fades out? Inspect the live configuration and answer.
Configure the Status Messages module on this site so that popup messages fade out after 10 seconds. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set status_messages.status_messages:status_message_time to 10000 (10 seconds in milliseconds) and save. Verified against live config.

evals.prompt: Our confirmation popups disappear too fast. Using the Status Messages module, make them stay on screen for 10 seconds before disappearing, and save the setting.
evals.expected_output: Set status_message_time to 10000 ms (10 seconds) in status_messages.status_messages and save. Verified against live config.
